plan.title: Invalid schedule when converting RFQ to auction

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the starting state.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the conversion flow.
Open the RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow and continue to the converted auction create screen.

args.goal: on the converted auction create screen, choose and save a schedule whose start time is before the closed RFQ ended, leaving the invalid schedule selected for publishing

steps.note: No catalog scheduling step can select an absolute start before the prior RFQ ended, so perform that schedule selection directly on the screen.
Attempt publishing and assert Procol refuses the invalid schedule with the expected message.
